newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady, demand average.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady, demand average.

text.p: Singapore bunker indications on Wednesday were little changed on average demand, brokers said.
A trader said freight costs are comparatively lower than rising fuel oil prices and shipowners are covering "only when they have to".
Bunker 180-cst supplies were quoted at $124 per tonne and 380-cst supplies at around $120. A major said prices in Singapore remained competitive.
MDO prices were little changed at $223-228 and gas oil at $234-$238.
